title: Stabilize guided replay motion and cursor contrast

fields.outcome: Walkthrough viewers can follow a calm camera that remains focused across related actions and can always see the pointer on dark or light application screens.
fields.scope: Replace repeated zoom-origin jumps with a translated focus camera that smoothly pans between click targets while staying zoomed, reset the zoom-out timer after each click, raise the default quiet hold interval, slow cursor travel independently from camera motion, render a white cursor with a black edge and a readable click ring, and update the portable AutoTour skill with a complete heading index and progressively disclosed presentation guidance.
fields.acceptance: During a click sequence, the replay zooms in once, smoothly pans to subsequent click targets without returning to full scale between them, and zooms out only after the configured holdMs quiet interval. Cursor travel is author-configurable and deliberately paced, while each click receives a persistent high-contrast emphasis. The cursor remains white with a black edge on dark and light screens. The internal skill explains how to choose pointer, click, hold, and camera timings and begins with a Content section linking every heading.
fields.decisions: Use a fixed top-left transform origin and animate translate plus scale so target changes interpolate as camera movement. Clamp translation to replay bounds. Treat holdMs as quiet time after the most recent click and recommend at least two step delays plus transition time. Override rrweb's 50 ms pointer transition and 200 ms pulse with configurable presentation timings and a high-contrast expanding ring. Keep detailed output configuration in skill reference files.
fields.verification: Add browser assertions for translated focus, movement between click targets without an intervening reset, delayed zoom-out, cursor styling, configurable pointer transition, visible click animation, and lifecycle reset. Validate the skill, regenerate and inspect the DealDesk DOM and WebM examples, run package checks, and run frozen Agenthouse evaluation.
fields.dependencies: Refines ST-12 guided motion and the create-autotour portable skill.
fields.risks: Long focus holds can obscure global context and aggressive translation can expose empty edges. Bound scale and translation, retain explicit configuration, and restore full view after quiet time and lifecycle controls.
fields.observed: The DealDesk example repeatedly zoomed in and out between nearby actions. After the first correction, the cursor remained too fast and rrweb's brief click pulse was still difficult to perceive.
fields.expected: Related clicks should feel like one calm focused sequence with slight camera movement, followed by one zoom-out after an author-controlled quiet interval; the pointer should travel deliberately and each click should be unmistakable.
fields.audience: Viewers of product walkthroughs and the teams producing them.
fields.changes: Implemented through commit dee6be0c00aa67ca26bbd4a318f09f02b09fa028: click focus uses bounded translate-and-scale camera movement and resets its quiet timer on each click. Pointer travel and click emphasis now have independent configurable durations, defaulting to 650 ms and 700 ms, with a white pointer and high-contrast expanding click ring. The create-autotour skill starts with a complete Content index and routes detailed pacing guidance into indexed reference files.
fields.evidence: Browser tests observed translated focus moving between two click targets without an intermediate zoom-out, verified an 850 ms cursor transition and 800 ms click animation, and covered quiet reset and lifecycle controls. The regenerated DealDesk example was visually inspected during a click and produces a valid 1440x900, 19.64-second VP8 WebM. The full package suite passed 84 tests, and frozen Agenthouse evaluation for the exact corrected build satisfied all seven configured checks.

criteria.expectation: focus.holdMs measures quiet time after the most recent click and controls when the replay zooms out.
Clicks arriving before holdMs expires keep the replay zoomed without an intermediate full-view reset.
Successive click targets move the focused camera through an animated bounded translation rather than a transform-origin jump.
The replay cursor is white with a black edge and remains legible over dark and light content.
Pointer travel duration is configurable independently from camera movement and supports deliberate walkthrough pacing.
Enabled click emphasis remains visible long enough to register and uses a high-contrast treatment over dark and light content.
Pause, restart, completion, resize, and reduced motion leave the replay in a stable full view.
The create-autotour skill starts with a Content section linking every heading and routes detailed presentation guidance to reference files.
